title: Design System: Anchor Studio by DNL

display.purpose: Landing only, width 92. Hero 44 / 56 (sm) / 64 (lg) px; closing heading 40 / 52 (sm) px; section heads 34 / 40 (sm) px.

headline.purpose: Page titles at 26 px; Sign in heading at 28 px.

subhead.purpose: 19 px: Visuals part title, anchor name in the Anchors detail; Script total runtime at this size in edge print.

section.purpose: 17 px section headings inside a page (Today's picks, Listen to each part); landing hero lede.

lede.purpose: 16 px landing section body, 60 ch max.

title.purpose: Dialog, sheet, panel and empty-state titles.

body-sm.purpose: Rows, captions, meta; 12 px floor for running text.

label-narrow.purpose: Step track, segmented controls, tabs, rail titles (font-stretch 84%).

edge-print.purpose: Every measurement: codes, times, counts, ring percentages, frame durations. Always amber, tabular.

tag.purpose: Uppercase mono chips for kinds, states and news categories.

marker-numeral.purpose: Play-order numerals on picked frames (42 px) and in the picked list (17 px). Bare red with a 6 px g0 stroke; never in a disc.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Centred dialogs over a 70% black, 3 px blur backdrop.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Right-edge sheet over a 50% black backdrop.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The system easing: marker loop, dialogs, sheets, menus, toasts, page changes, rings and fill bars.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Declared alternative; expo is the default.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Colour, border and press transitions on controls.

motion.name: marker-loop
motion.purpose: The loop draws in 220 ms; the numeral follows after 160 ms. No spring.

motion.name: page
motion.purpose: Step change: fade and 10 px slide.

motion.name: indicator
motion.purpose: Only the sliding selection indicators of nav, step track and segmented controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition durations.

narrative.overview:
Every story is a roll of film. The editor works on film-rebate black, looks at found footage laid out as frames on a darker sheet, marks the ones to use with a red china-marker loop and a hand-written play-order numeral, and reads every time, code and count as amber edge print. The interface is dense and desktop-first (1280 px and up), a working instrument for several stories a day, not a showcase.

One graphite ramp of eleven slightly blue steps carries every neutral: grounds, surfaces, hairline seams and text. Colour is spent on meaning only. DNL red is selection, the primary action and on-air; amber is measurement; violet and steel blue tell anchor parts from voiceover parts; green, yellow and red-pink report state. One workhorse sans (Archivo) does everything, using its width axis for condensed labels, and JetBrains Mono prints the edge numbers.

The world borrows the contact sheet's logic, not its costume: no sprocket holes, film grain or imitation stock. Depth comes from tonal steps and hairlines; shadows are neutral and only lift floating layers. Motion is short expo ease-out, and the signature loop draws in 220 ms.
keyCharacteristics: Film-rebate black ground with an eleven-step graphite ramp.
Amber mono edge print for every measurement: frame codes (R02·F01a), timecodes, durations, counts.
DNL red as the china marker: picked frames, primary action, on-air, active nav.
Hairline seams and tight 2 to 5 px corners.
Archivo for words (width axis for condensed labels), JetBrains Mono for numbers, Caveat Brush only for picked numerals.
Expo ease-out motion; the signature loop has no spring.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: No colour is decorative. If a hue appears, it is marking a pick, a measurement, a part kind or a state.

rules.name: The g8 Floor Rule
rules.body: Graphite 8 is the lowest step that may carry text; every text must meet WCAG AA. Graphite 7 and darker are for borders, placeholders and disabled states only.

rules.name: The Edge-Print Rule
rules.body: Every measurement (time, code, count, percent of a target) is set in mono, tabular, in edge-print amber.

rules.name: The Narrow Rule
rules.body: The condensed width (84%) is for labels that sit in tracks and rails: step track, segmented controls, tabs, rail titles. Body and headings stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Bare Numeral Rule
rules.body: Caveat Brush appears only as play-order numerals on picked frames and in the picked list. It is written bare in marker red with a ground-coloured stroke (6 px of g0, painted under the fill), never inside a disc or badge.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading: no eyebrow, no kicker. Category and status tags go in a meta row below the title.

rules.name: The Proportional Rail Rule
rules.body: In the parts rail, each part's height is its seconds: 7 px per second, with a 44 px floor. Short parts drop their text snippet rather than break the proportion.

rules.name: The Contact Sheet Rule
rules.body: Found frames sit on the sheet-black panel (5 px corners, a g4 hairline ring, 16 px inside) headed by one mono amber, uppercase count line: roll, videos, frames, picked, seconds of target.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black. No coloured glows.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation by stepping up the graphite ramp and taking a hairline, not by casting a shadow.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: No imitation film material: no sprocket holes, perforations, grain, light leaks or rebate lettering. The contact sheet is a layout idea, not a texture.

dos: **Do** set every measurement (times, codes, counts, durations against target) in mono, tabular, edge-print amber.
**Do** reserve marker red for picks, the primary action, on-air and live progress, keyboard focus and news-category tags.
**Do** keep text at g8 or brighter and every text pair at AA; keep running text at 12 px or larger.
**Do** use the condensed width only for labels in tracks and rails: step track, segmented controls, tabs, rail titles.
**Do** put category and status tags in a meta row below the heading.
**Do** size parts-rail entries at 7 px per second with a 44 px floor.
**Do** lay found frames on the sheet-black panel under a mono amber count line.
**Do** animate on expo ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); 150 ms for hover, 220 ms for the marker loop, 240 to 320 ms for dialogs, sheets and page changes.
donts: **Don't** use Caveat Brush anywhere but play-order numerals on picked frames and in the picked list, and never put the numeral in a disc.
**Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** imitate film material: no sprocket holes, perforations or grain.
**Don't** use coloured glow shadows; shadows are black.
**Don't** use g7 or darker for readable text.
**Don't** put a spring on the marker loop.
